notes.title: Major August Update
notes.notes:
UI Overhaul:

Most UI elements have been redesigned.

A small portion of floating text will be optimized in future versions to better support multilingual compatibility and font licensing.
[p align="start"]BGM Changes:

Several background music tracks have been replaced with ones that better fit the game’s scenarios.
[p align="start"]New Appearances:

4 new male short hairstyles.

1 new male outfit.
[p align="start"]New Boss:

Spear WarLord: Wields a corrupted holy spear and is one of the Five Generals of the Demon King’s Army.

Players will encounter him at Wave 30 in Bridge Defense mode and in the final moments of Survivor Mode.
[p align="start"]Level Cap Increased to 30
[p align="start"]New Tier 3 Weapons:

A third evolution stage has been added for all weapons. Check the Weapon Index for details.

The Battle Axe has been temporarily removed due to its similarity to the Light Steel Axe. This weapon path will be redeveloped in a future update, potentially evolving into unique weapons such as a Scythe or Pickaxe.
[p align="start"]New Awakening Skills:

After job advancement, characters will unlock two inactive Awakening Skills (viewable in the Index).

Upon reaching Level 15, players can choose one of these skills to activate.

Awakening Skills function similarly to dual-class or secondary advancements, granting stronger abilities and more diverse build possibilities.
[p align="start"]New Dodge Mechanic:

If a character’s Movement Speed exceeds 5, each point of Movement Speed grants 10% Dodge Chance.

Armor skills now come with a downside: reduced Movement Speed and a significant decrease in Dodge Chance.

Unless otherwise specified, using an Armor+ skill will reduce Dodge Chance to 0.

Note: Movement Speed is capped at 15, and Dodge Chance cannot exceed 80%.

Mounted classes will be forcibly slowed down upon colliding with larger enemies (e.g., Bosses and Trolls). Pay attention to collisions when slowed or unable to dodge.
[p align="start"]Class Reworks:

Knight: Removes all negative effects from \[Armor] skill.

ImperialGuard: When taking damage, instantly restores 2% max HP.

Chieftain: Temporarily removed.

Due to changes in Armor, Dodge, Movement Speed, and other mechanics, some classes have undergone balance adjustments.

notes.title: Major June Update (Part 1)
notes.notes:
New Enemies Added:

Spider Queen (Boss) – Pouncing claw attack, venom orb, web bind

Poison Spider – Airdrop unit, ranged

Stone Spider – Airdrop unit, rolling charge

Ogre Shieldbearer	 – Tank, shield block, collision damage

Ogre Butcher – Tank, wide-range attack

Treasure Goblin – Survivor Mode exclusive, flees rapidly, drops 1-5 relic bags and other items upon death.



Enemy Adjustments:

Increased HP for some enemies while slightly reducing movement speed, making smaller enemies more durable.



Relic Changes:

Added 9 new skill books.

Baby dragons can now evolve into adult dragons.



Bridge Defense Mode – New Defensive Structures:

Arrow Tower:

Defensive tower that fires an arrow at the nearest enemy every 2 seconds. Arrow damage: \[&1], receives bow-related bonuses and all damage bonuses from the captain.

Fence

An obstacle that blocks enemies and projectiles. Initial shield value: \[&1], benefits from party's shield bonuses.



Bridge Defense Mode Revamp:

Due to new enemies, defensive structures, skill books, etc., the stage layouts have been redesigned.

Increased enemy count in early waves for New Game+ to raise difficulty and improve replay value.



Survivor Mode – Formation Synergy Removed:

The formation synergy system has been removed, no longer restricting weapon choices or requiring early class changes.

Some formation skills have been integrated into relics—obtain the relic to activate the corresponding skill.



Survivor Mode Difficulty Reset:

Now only 6 difficulty tiers (0-5), each tier increasing difficulty by 50%.

Difficulty 5 is the maximum; clearing it will no longer increase difficulty, only refresh the fastest clear time.



Survivor Mode Spawn Logic Reworked:

Redesigned enemy spawning and loot drops for greater randomness, optimizing replay experience.

notes.title: April 18 Update
notes.notes:
Added new Item Section to the Library.

Added 6 new Relics：

Hemostatic Bandage

When any ally takes damage exceeding 20 points, immediately restores half of the damage taken as HP. This relic has a 5-second cooldown after triggering.

War Drum

When any ally triggers [Double Strike], restores 1% of max HP to the entire party. This relic has a 2-second cooldown after triggering.

Red Armband

When the captain triggers [Combo Attack], grants 1 stack of [Inspiration] to the whole party (max 50 stacks). Each stack increases all damage dealt by 1%. [Inspiration] stacks are halved every second.

Blue Armband

When the captain triggers [Critical Strike], grants 2 stacks of [Inspiration] to the whole party (max 50 stacks). Each stack increases all damage dealt by 1%. [Inspiration] stacks are halved every second.

Yellow Armband

When the captain triggers [Double Strike], grants 5 stacks of [Inspiration] to the whole party (max 50 stacks). Each stack increases all damage dealt by 1%. [Inspiration] stacks are halved every second.

Trap Strategy

When any ally uses [Trap], reduces cooldown of [Trap] skills for other allies by 1 second. In Bridge Defense mode, calculated per team.

notes.title: April 16 Update

In Adventure Mode Stage 1, a 【？？？】 character will temporarily join your party.

notes.title: April 10 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Adjusted appearance for some classes.

Added new green ponytail hairstyle.

Increased character movement speed.

Increased damage dealt by certain enemies.

Hunter-advanced jobs (Ranger/Scout) can now ride mounts after job advancement if wielding eligible weapons.

Increased attack speed of Guan Dao (Halberd).

Reduced damage of Falcon and Varg, but increased their movement speed.

Added visual effects to display the range of the Warrior’s 【Aura Field】 skill.

Formation Bond Adjustments

Arrow Formation: 【Rain of Arrows】 now scales with the Captain’s critical strike. Base damage slightly reduced.

Sword Formation Lv.5: New skill unlocked –
【Sword Qi】: Sword attacks release a sword beam. Beam damage equals 30% of weapon damage, with width scaling based on weapon length.

Class Buffs
Ranger

Ranger's movement speed increased by 25%, and movement speed is not reduced while attacking. Gains increasing chance to evade all damage based on movement speed (higher speed = greater evasion).

Can now advance to Ranger even with  Taming (off-hand).

Berserker

Critical Hit HP recovery increased from 3% to 4%.

Class Nerfs
Pirate

Spinning Axe now consumes 2% of max HP (previously 2% of current HP).

notes.title: April 6 Update Notes
notes.notes:
Enemy Changes

Gnoll Shieldbearers

Removed damage reduction against arrows and javelins (only blocks bullets now)

Increased base HP

Class Reworks

Warrior

Can now use javelins/throwing axes as primary weapons

Unlocks cavalry promotion when mounted


New promotions:

Javelin → SpearMaster

Throwing Axe → AxeMaster

Steel Axe/Throwing Axe → Chieftain


VargCavalry (Reworked)

When riding their tamed [Varg] in combat, VargCavalry's movement speed is replaced by the [Varg]'s movement speed. With a 50% chance to evade all damage and simultaneously countering adjacent enemies with a Claw Attacks equal to the Varg's final damage.

Class Buffs

Assassin: Execute chance on non-elites 5% → 20%

Heavy Knight: Shield cost for charge 10 → 5

Class Nerfs

GiantSwordsmen:

Triple-charge damage 500%+500% → 400%+400%

Berserker:

Healing cooldown 2s → 3s

Formation Adjustments

Spear Formation (Lv6-10):

[Coordinated Thrust]: Range increased, cooldown 5s → 2s

Axe Formation (Lv3):

[Frenzy]: Initial kill requirement 10 → 3 (scales with level, reaches 3 at Lv10)


New: Beast Formation

Automatically levels up and gains skills based on the number of promoted classes who have learned [Taming] in the party. 
Lv2: [Beast Synergy] grants all party members +4% all damage dealt and +10 Max HP per level .
Lv3: [Wild Call] summons a random wild animal to join the party every 5 seconds  (animals benefit from the Captain's buffs).Max: 6 summons.
Lv5: [Wild Call+] Increases the level of summoned animals.

Relic Updates
Leather Armor: Reduces damage taken by 30% when any party member takes a hit exceeding 10% of max HP.

Sniper Scope: Ranged attacks have 10% chance to pierce all targets

Item Drop Changes

White Phoenix Feather:

Effect: "Revives all dead allies with 50% HP"

Now rarer with increased drop cooldown

notes.title: March 28th Update Notes

Survivor Mode Changes:

New difficulty selection system:

Base difficulty starts at 0

Unlocks +1 max selectable difficulty per cleared tier

Enemies gain +10% strength

+1 global reset charge

+5% in-match item drop rate

Bug Fixes:

New Formation Synergy:

Heart Formation

"Scales with the number of promoted classes who learned [Focus]."

Lv2: [Focus Synergy]

Grants all allies 6% damage nullification per level (Max: 30%).

Lv3: [Mind's Eye]

Focus-users gain 20% chance to deal double damage.

Weapon Synergy Adjustments:

(Sword/Spear/Axe Formations)

notes.title: March 25 Update Notes
notes.notes:
New Relics:

Berries
Restores 15 HP to the Captain every 10 seconds.

Sniper Eyepiece
When the Captain uses ranged weapons, there's a 10% chance to penetrate all targets.

Leather Armor
When the Captain takes damage, there's a 50% chance to reduce incoming damage by half.

Relic Adjustments:

Staff of Fireballs
Fireball damage increased from 120 to 200.

Class Changes:

Berserker:

For every 2% decrease in HP, both Berserker's Critical Rate and Critical Damage increase by 1%.

When a [Critical Strike] is not triggered, 4% of current HP is consumed.

When a [Critical Strike] is triggered, 4% of Max HP is restored(2s CD).

notes.title: March 22 Update Notes
notes.notes:
System Optimizations:

Added a "Retry" button to the exit menu.

Added a Codex button to the upgrade and card selection interface, allowing players to quickly open and close the codex.

AI Improvements:

When using the Gather command, AI teammates will prioritize moving to the gathering point over attacking if they are too far away.

Bridge Defense Mode Changes:

Added a "List of Oncoming Demon Army" to track incoming enemies.

Increased the cost of upgrading soldiers.

Difficulty has been raised, and the difficulty curve has been readjusted.

Adventure Mode Changes:

Difficulty has been raised, and boss health has been increased.

notes.title: March 14 Update
notes.notes:
New Features:

New Item Drop System:

In Adventure Mode and Survivor Mode, defeating a certain number of demon soldiers will now have a chance to drop items.

The current version includes 5 types of drop items:

Relic Bag: Randomly grants a relic. Has a chance to drop relics from defeated bosses and all types of books. Exclusive to Survivor Mode.

White Feather: Revives a fallen teammate and restores 50% of their HP. If no teammates are dead, restores 50% HP to the teammate with the lowest current HP percentage.

Red Potion: Restores 30% HP to the teammate with the lowest current HP percentage.

Orange Potion: Grants the entire team a 30% attack damage boost for 20 seconds.

Blue Potion: Grants the entire team a 30% movement speed boost for 20 seconds.

Items left uncollected for more than 20 seconds will be automatically picked up.


New Card Reset Feature:

Characters will gain 1 card reset opportunity every 5 levels.


Adventure Mode Changes:

Added item drops.

Reduced the health of the Gnoll Vanguard (Boss) and Goblin Shaman (Boss).

When a boss appears, demon soldiers will no longer spawn in large numbers. Instead, they will spawn continuously in smaller numbers, with the total number of spawns per level remaining unchanged.

Defeating a boss will grant experience for all unspawned demon soldiers.


Survivor Mode Changes:

Added item drops.

Removed automatic revival and automatic recovery.

Slightly reduced experience gain.

Increased late-game difficulty. The final wave will now spawn 4 Gnoll Vanguards (Boss).


Bridge Defense Mode Changes:

The relic search function has been changed to a chance to drop relics from defeated bosses and all types of books, consistent with picking up Relic Bags in Survivor Mode.

Old save files will need to defeat bosses again for statistics to be updated.

Bug Fixes:

After manually entering or randomly generating a name for a character, changing their class or gender will no longer randomly rename them.

Fixed an issue where the Bear's shield burst damage did not receive pet bonuses.

Fixed an issue in Bridge Defense Mode where pets would not attack if they were too far from the team.

Balance Adjustments:

Slightly increased the stats of thrown spears and axes.

Enhanced the scale of Arrow Rain for Level 3 and Level 4 Bow Formations, making 3-Bow and 4-Bow Formations a viable option.

Class Buffs:


Assassin:

The Assassin's default Critical Damage  is increased to 300%. 

Their weapon attacks have a 5% chance to instantly kill non-elite enemies.


Noble:

Noble's attack interval is doubled, while the final damage is tripled. Stay elegant! 

When Noble triggers a [Critical Strike], increases movement speed by 100% and evades all damage for 0.5 seconds. Stay light!


SpearGuard:

When the SpearGuard triggers a [Critical Strike], it reduces the movement speed of the hit enemy by 80% for 2 seconds. This effect also applies to bosses.

 Damage dealt to enemies with reduced movement speed is increased by 30%.


Headhunter:

The Headhunter prioritizes attacking enemy bosses. 

When HeadHunter triggers a [Critical Strike], it marks the hit enemy, increasing the damage they take by an additional 30%. The mark lasts for 2 seconds, applies to bosses., and multiple marks do not stack.


VargTamer:

Increases  VargTamer's  own Critical rate by 20%. 

Their tamed [Varg] gains [Critical Strike], with Critical Rate and Critical Damage equal to VargTamer's. The VargTamer can tame an additional 1 [Varg]. Additional Varg start at Level 1.


Scout:

The movement speed of all the Scout's allies is increased by 20%. 

When  the Scout's [Falcon] hits an enemy, it marks the target, increasing the damage they take by an additional 30%. The mark lasts for 2 seconds, applies to bosses, and multiple marks do not stack.


AI Optimization:

Teammates will now judge the attack direction of enemies. They will no longer dodge if they are behind the enemy and outside its attack range.

Berserkers and Nobles will no longer dodge attacks after learning [Critical Strike+].

Swordsmen will no longer dodge attacks after reaching Stage 2 of their charge.

All cavalry units will no longer dodge attacks while running and having a movement speed greater than 7.

Improved the targeting priority of ranged classes and pets when attacking bosses.


Future Optimization Plans:

Add a list in Bridge Defense Mode showing the number of remaining enemies per wave.

Add a timer to Survivor Mode.

Add keybinding support.

New Formations:

Holy Formation (Sacred Weapon Synergy)

Beast Formation (Beast Tamer Synergy)

Acknowledgments:

We would like to thank all the friends who have been following and supporting us since the release of the trial version. Your participation and feedback have helped us identify many issues in the game.

We will continue to improve and make "Isekai Captain" a game that everyone loves.

By Song, Developer of "Isekai Captain"

notes.title: March 1st Update
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:

Fixed corrupted audio issues.

Fixed an issue in Bridge Defense mode where players could not progress to the third playthrough.

New Feature:

You can now continue from your second playthrough (Stage 30) save file. After clearing the stage, you will be able to enter the third playthrough.

Playthroughs are endless, but the difficulty increases significantly with each cycle. Not all team compositions will be able to clear multiple playthroughs, so optimize your lineup and use relics to continuously boost your team's stats to face the challenges of higher playthroughs.

notes.title: February 28rd Update
notes.notes:
Optimization for Special Screens:

When the game launches, if the screen's aspect ratio does not match the game's resolution, the game will automatically switch to windowed mode.

When changing the resolution on special screens, if the resolution is incompatible, the game will enforce windowed mode and default resolution.

Since the game camera and UI are not designed to handle stretched displays, special screens will temporarily only support windowed mode. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

If you encounter any issues that prevent you from playing, please let us know.


Keyboard Key Support:

Added support for pressing the ESC key to exit the main menu.

Full keyboard and controller support is planned for future updates. Due to the complexity of the game's interface, this will take some time to implement.


Bug Fixes:

Fixed an issue in Bridge Defense mode where the movement speed buff during preparation was occasionally not removed when combat started.

Fixed some text errors and missing text.

Fixed an issue where the Gnolls Vanguard's boomerang axe would overlap with characters during invincibility frames.

AI Optimization:

Hunters will now try to space out their use of campfires in terms of timing and location.

New Mechanics:

Berserkers will no longer be knocked back when their health drops below 50%.

Critical hits will now display more noticeable damage numbers.

Balance Adjustments:

This game features many classes and modes, and each class has its strengths in different scenarios. Some are defensive, some are control-oriented, some are supportive, some excel at clearing mobs, and others are better at single-target damage or adapting to open or narrow environments.

For example, Snipers and BearTamers are very strong in Bridge Defense mode but perform averagely in Survival mode.

If you feel that your favorite class is underpowered or struggles in most scenarios, please let us know. We will analyze and optimize it.

If your team composition is reasonably balanced but still feels weak, we welcome your feedback. We will analyze and decide whether to buff these combinations.

Game balance will remain a focus of ongoing updates and optimizations.

— By Song, Producer of "Isekai Captain"

_____________________________________________________________
Accidentally Deleted Announcement from February 23rd: XD

February 23rd Update:

Temporary Mechanics for Survival Mode:

Previous: In Survival mode, fallen teammates would automatically revive after 60 seconds.

New: In Survival mode, every 30 seconds, the teammate with the lowest health will recover 30% of their health.

This is equivalent to finding a healing potion every 30 seconds, making it easier for teams with insufficient healing to avoid losing members early on.

These temporary mechanics will be replaced by the upcoming in-game item drop system. Once implemented, enemies will randomly drop healing potions, buff potions, revival feathers, relic chests, and more. At that time, the auto-revive and auto-heal mechanics will be removed.

Other Optimizations:

Mounted units will no longer be knocked back when hit.

Varg Cavalry and Bear Cavalry will no longer attack while sprinting; their pets will only attack when moving slowly or standing still.

Shortbow Varg Cavalry now consume one-third of the kinetic energy compared to other weapons when attacking, to better match the shortbow's fast and easy-to-use nature.

AI optimization for ranged classes: When close to a boss and no nearby enemies are present, ranged units will prioritize targeting the boss.

About the Game:
"Isekai Captain" is designed to simplify controls while emphasizing team building, character development, and class transitions. As the captain your role is to guide your team and ensure their survival, which is often the key to victory. Of course, the game also offers classes that allow you to charge into battle and dominate the field, such as Dual-Blade Rangers, Giant Axe Fighter, Guan Dao Cavalry, and Long Sword Cavalry. These classes have wide attack ranges and high mobility. There are even more playstyles waiting to be discovered!

— By Song, Producer of "Isekai Captain"

notes.title: Patch Notes for February 24rd
notes.notes:
Bridge Defense Mode Updates:

Traps and campfires will now be cleared from the battlefield after each wave victory. The cleanup crew is hard at work!

During preparation time, the captain and all team members gain a 100% movement speed boost to quickly regroup.

Team members can now swap positions between the front and rear lines.

Other Adjustments:

Goblin Archers' firing range has been reduced, but their arrow flight distance remains unchanged.

Improved penetration for all allied projectiles. Arrows and javelins can now pierce through more enemies.
Note: Some monsters, like Gnoll Shield Soldiers, have shields that are nearly impenetrable.

Bug Fixes:

Fixed a progression-blocking issue caused by excessive Slime merging. 

The Bear Shield ability for BearTamers and BearCavalry now correctly consumes 5 shield points when pushing enemies away. This fix has slightly weakened the ability.

Fixed an issue where the Holy Axe could be selected multiple times.


We Want Your Feedback!

If you encounter any issues, have suggestions, or want to share ideas for new content, please join our player community or let us know in the forums!


                                                                                                         by Song, Producer of "Isekai Captain"
